title: Pipe Dreams
summary: Will pipelines cloud the outlook for the tanker market? A number of years ago, there was much discussion about new pipeline construction and expansion projects and their potential impact on tanker demand. Recently it has become quiet, in particular with respect to pipelines outside of North America.
